entities.summary: Jungo Morita is a retired volleyball player from Japan. He competed at the 1968 and 1972 Olympics and won a silver and a gold medal, respectively. In 2003, he was inducted into the Volleyball Hall of Fame in Holyoke, Massachusetts. Jungo Morita was a athletes & competitors from Kitami (b. 1947-08-09, Kitami).
